♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 DON KAM! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions wit **Your script** ɛn **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, ɛn **Flex Studio (Beta)** we kin download fɔs ɛn aks yu bifo i instɔl.

*(Instɔl am oba di vɔshɔn we yu gɛt naw ɛn ristat After Effects wan tɛm.)*

♦️ **Nyu: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Di **Map desk** layout, fɔ fɛn ples dɛn we intanɛt nɔ de, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route ɛn ɔda wan dɛn), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, fri map stayl dɛn ɛn **Open in Flex Maps**.
* In ɛkstra tul dɛn (layv sink, stayl dɛn, lebul dɛn, 3D, Finalize) de rili lod insay After Effects naw.

♦️ **Nyu tin dɛn na AutoCaptions**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (klawd, i de yuz Flex AI kredit) na di enjin we wi rɛkɔmɛnd, ɛn wi pik am wan tɛm fɔ ɔlman. Pik Whisper bak fɔ mek kapshɔn fri na yu kɔmpyuta (Translate To nid Whisper). If di sava bizi, i go sho yu ples na di layn.
* **Your script**: di kapshɔn dɛn go tek di spɛlin ɛn di wɔd dɛn frɔm yu skript ɛnisay we yu bin se dɛn wɔd de.
* **Editable template** autput: kapshɔn dɛn as tɛmplet lea we yu kin chenj dɛn stayl na Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* Yu nɔ pik natin ɛn Source media ɛmti? I go ɔfa yu di **ɔl kɔmpozishɔn**. Di sem ɔdio kin yuz in transkript bak.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** kin download am, dɔn i go aks **Install / Not now**.
* Di ap (2.0.0-beta.2): **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING** wokspes dɛn, After Effects tul ki dɛn, klip dɛn kin opin wantɛm wantɛm, ɛn OPEN de wok pan prikɔmp ɛn ajɔstmɛnt lea dɛn.

♦️ **Wetin wi fiks**
* Di tim ɛfɛkt dɛn we bin dɔn lɔs pan bɔku Windows PC dɔn kam bak (dɛn layt if Windows animeshɔn ɛfɛkt dɛn ɔf).

♦️ **Lokeshɔn fɔ protɛkt di laysɛns (na yu chɔys)**
* Wi go aks yu wan tɛm nɔmɔ, ɛn na yu chɔys: if yu pik **No thanks**, ɔltin go kɔntinyu fɔ wok. Yu kin chenj am na **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Wi kip am fɔ 12 mɔnt, wi nɔ ɛva sɛl am, ɛn wi nɔ ɛva sheb am pas if di lɔ se fɔ du am.

ult.message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 DON KAM! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack dɔn muf go insay AutoCaptions** wit stayl fɔ ɛni wɔd, layout, mɔshɔn ɛn sawnd. **UN-NEST** ɛn blend mod dɛn de wok pan Premiere 26.5, **AUTO CUT** na wan prɛs nɔmɔ, ɛn **Flex Studio (Beta)** kin opin yu klip frɔm di panɛl.

*(Instɔl am oba di vɔshɔn we yu gɛt naw ɛn ristat Premiere Pro wan tɛm.)*

♦️ **Nyu: Kapshɔn we de muv na AutoCaptions**
* **Wɔd stayl**: gi ɛni wɔd in yon kɔlɔ, fɔnt ɛn Flat, Shine ɔ Glow finish.
* **Layn layout dɛn**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside ɛn Line.
* **Mɔshɔn fɔ ɛni wɔd** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake ɛn ɔda wan dɛn) wit priviu, ɛn bak **Pop / Tick / Swoosh** sawnd dɛn. Wɔd stayl ɛn mɔshɔn nid di **Images** autput.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (klawd, i de yuz Flex AI kredit) na di enjin we wi rɛkɔmɛnd naw, ɛn wi pik am wan tɛm fɔ ɔlman; pik Whisper enjin fɔ mek kapshɔn fri we intanɛt nɔ de.
* **Your script** (Captions mod): di kapshɔn dɛn go tek di wɔd dɛn frɔm yu skript usay yu bin se dɛn wɔd de.
* If yu nɔ pik natin (Source kad ɛmti), i go ɔfa yu di **ɔl taymlayn**; di kapshɔn dɛn go sev nia yu prɔjek.

♦️ **Nyu: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** de trak di klip insay di ap; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** de sɛn di trak bak. I nɔ instɔl yet? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** go download am, dɔn i go aks **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Wetin chenj**
* **AUTO CUT** de stɔdi di klip we yu pik ɛn kɔt am wit wan prɛs. **Retakes** de ketch layn dɛn we yu bigin bak.
* **Audio Studio** gɛt siks sɔb-tab naw. Di **Library** de na Nest Saver.

♦️ **Wetin wi fiks**
* **UN-NEST** pan Premiere 26.5 (i bin de rifyuz ɛvri nest), ɛn blend mod dɛn lɛk Screen we bin de go bak to Normal (Premiere na Inglish).
* Di rɛd **AUTOSAVE 0:00** chip, di blak Caption Stack priviu, ɛn di tim ɛfɛkt dɛn we bin lɔs pan bɔku Windows PC.

♦️ **Lokeshɔn fɔ protɛkt di laysɛns (na yu chɔys)**
* Wi go aks yu wan tɛm nɔmɔ, ɛn na yu chɔys: if yu pik **No thanks**, ɔltin go kɔntinyu fɔ wok. Yu kin chenj am na **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Wi kip am fɔ 12 mɔnt, wi nɔ ɛva sɛl am, ɛn wi nɔ ɛva sheb am pas if di lɔ se fɔ du am.
